description: GNSS Zero-baseline Configuration Data is provided by Depositing research team via Zenodo. The dataset contains GNSS observations and broadcast ephemerides from two high-precision receivers sharing one antenna in a zero-baseline experiment on 8 March 2024. Geographic context: unknown; not established by landing-page metadata. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: not established on the reviewed page. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. This is a controlled single experiment; it does not represent spatially separated receiver networks. Potential simulation use: Compare receiver errors and positioning-model calibration. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnss-sdr offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
